module_summary: Randomized exponential backoff timer: a 16-bit LFSR masked by an exponentially growing shift-register mask loads a down-counter whose zero flag permits retries.

anchors.name: cnt_q
anchors.why: Backoff down-counter loaded with masked random value, decremented to zero.

anchors.name: lfsr_q
anchors.why: 16-bit LFSR shift register providing random wait counts.

anchors.name: mask_q
anchors.why: Exponential mask shift register widening on each failed trial.

anchors.name: set_cnt_i
anchors.why: Trial-failed pulse: advances LFSR, widens mask and loads counter.

anchors.name: clr_cnt_i
anchors.why: Trial-succeeded pulse: clears mask and counter.

anchors.name: is_zero_o
anchors.why: Counter-zero indication allowing a new trial; also stops decrement.

anchors.name: lfsr
anchors.why: LFSR feedback XOR bit shifted into lfsr_q.

groups.name: random_generator
groups.description: LFSR and exponential mask generating masked random backoff values.

groups.name: backoff_counter
groups.description: Down-counter loaded on set and zero-detect output.

groups.name: command_inputs
groups.description: Set/clear pulses sequencing LFSR, mask and counter updates.
